subject.title: fix(groq): keep default Llama agent turns within TPM limit

question: After the explicit top-level budget defect is fixed, should OpenClaw preserve implicit catalog output reservations and use Groq-specific recovery, or redefine the shared OpenAI-compatible transport default?
rationale: The two open fixes encode mutually exclusive cross-provider semantics; correctness review can repair this branch but cannot choose the permanent product/runtime policy.

options.title: Use narrow Groq recovery
options.body: Preserve successful shared-transport behavior and recover only the proven Groq model and error case after all explicit budgets are protected.

options.title: Change shared reservation policy
options.body: Prefer the broader transport change only after live multi-provider compatibility and upgrade proof demonstrates that omitted implicit reservations are safe.

recommendation.title: Use narrow Groq recovery
recommendation.body: Preserve successful shared-transport behavior and recover only the proven Groq model and error case after all explicit budgets are protected.

likelyOwner.reason: The history most strongly connects this person to both provider ownership migration and the shared OpenAI transport implementation.
